decisions.reason: The machine lettering is used as an existing font and capitalization reference for the base logo; the source does not require changing the machine placard.
The source changes the base logo's leaf, font, and letter case but does not change any body, accent, support-base, or font color.
The support-base logo treatment does not alter the DJ-turntable visual theme or decorative controls.
The logo decision does not affect bowl capacity, depth, geometry, refilling, or enclosure-size constraints.
The base logo styling change has no effect on splash targets, guards, or high-speed splash mitigation.
The source does not change spout geometry, material, mounting, orientation, appearance, or pour direction.
Changing graphics on the support base does not modify the accepted enclosure bulk or form factor.
The branding decision does not affect mixing quality, foam, whisk selection, positioning, or high-speed behavior.
The capitalization and font instruction is explicitly for the base logo, not the cursive K markings on dispense buttons.
Although the logo is located on the support base, its styling does not change the platform's height, footprint, cup clearance, or structural configuration.
The support-base logo change does not affect dispensing controls, valve behavior, flow, dripping, or dispensing sequence.
The source specifies a visual treatment for the base logo and does not necessarily revise the component BOM or its compatibility requirements.
